title: CLI error and refusal lines that carry stored text escape through the terminal text policy
outcome: CLI error and refusal lines that carry stored text escape through the terminal text policy
acceptance: a hostile-input regression drives a refusal and a generic error through the CLI binary and asserts no C0/C1/format character on any stderr line, one line per message, with the JSON form exact

every text-mode error or refusal line printed by the CLI entry point that embeds stored or caller-supplied text (item titles, reasons, refs, paths not already framed by terminal_detail) passes through the existing terminal text policy; --json output keeps stored bytes

completion.summary: CLI error and refusal lines now go through the terminal text policy; process tests assert no C0/C1/format on stderr and exact JSON envelopes; structured JSON keeps source bytes
